publicNotes:
## Build Notes

This build turns a bright water garden into a Monet-style pond, layering duckweed, white and pink flowers, blue hedges, and a soft green bridge over a clear pool. A red canoe anchors the right side while hanging vines and tall garden flowers make the cottage edge feel lush and overgrown.

The source frames focus on the finished scene rather than a material list, so the item list below is visually inferred from the screenshots and video thumbnail.
